args.title: Saltmarsh: Warehouse Automation 2026 – Summary
args.body:
- Autonomous carts raised warehouse pick rates by 18% in 2026.
- Integration took about twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece: the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Sources: https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/warehouse ; https://insights.saltmarsh.example/warehouse/companion
